install.download: Choose Antigravity 2.0 on the official download page and select the installer matching the OS and architecture. Antigravity IDE is a separate product.

agent_steps: Detect the OS and architecture, then check for an installed Antigravity 2.0 executable or package registration.
Download the matching Antigravity 2.0 installer from https://antigravity.google/download. Do not substitute Antigravity IDE or the agy CLI.
Open the native installer for the user and verify the Antigravity 2.0 executable after completion. Sign in inside the native app.

identity_guard.description: Antigravity 2.0 is Google's standalone agent desktop app. It has its own installation and data directory; do not identify the separate Antigravity IDE or Gemini Desktop as this app. EchoBird manages Google accounts, not Gemini API settings.
